subject: Pilot launch: final MAP signoff & signature window
message_1_subject: Re: pilot timeline & MAP - need final signoff window
message_1_body:
Thanks for the MAP and the close plan, Jonas. We reviewed the draft with procurement this morning. Two asks before we can move to signature: 1) a hard start date in December (we prefer 12/07 but need to confirm with ops), and 2) confirmation of the final approver list and who signs the SOW vs. the Master Order.

Can you send a short note confirming the signature window (dates/times) and whether Redwood will accept an e-signed SOW + DocuSign on behalf of both parties? Attaching our internal target calendar for the week.

—Elena
Head of Innovation, Northbridge Finance
---
Attachment: NB_internal_calendar_week_dec.ics (referenced)
message_2_subject: Re: pilot timeline & MAP - need final signoff window
message_2_body:
Hi Elena — thanks for the quick review and the calendar. We can accommodate a December 7 start; proposed signature window is 12/03–12/06 (electronic-first, with in-person signoff on 12/07 if needed). Please confirm if that aligns with procurement.

For clarity: Redwood accepts DocuSign for both the SOW and the MAP amendment. The SOW will be signed by our VP of Sales (Marissa Cole) and the Master Order will be countersigned by Legal if any changes are made. If Northbridge needs an additional signature block for an ops lead, we can add it to the SOW template.

I attached a clean MAP v3 and the draft SOW for your legal team — mark any redlines directly in the doc and we’ll fast-track.

Action items: 
- Elena/Tom: confirm target sign date (12/03–12/06 ok?) and who will sign on NB side.
- Marissa: confirm you can sign the SOW week of 12/3.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198
Attachments: MAP_Northbridge_v3.pdf, SOW_Northbridge_draft.docx
message_3_subject: RE: pilot timeline & MAP - need final signoff window
message_3_body:
Looping in Dev to confirm procurement/legal timeline on our end. Jonas — I can sign the SOW during the 12/03–12/06 window. Two points to confirm before I click:
1) Any final pricing concessions that require VP approval? (We agreed one-time onboarding credit; confirm amounts in SOW.)
2) Are there any CISO / SOC artifacts still outstanding that Legal needs before countersign?

If Dev confirms no blocker, I will schedule the signature in my calendar and prepare the DocuSign envelope.

—Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
message_4_subject: RE: pilot timeline & MAP - need final signoff window
message_4_body:
Marissa / Jonas — Legal has one small redline on data retention (requesting explicit 90-day log retention language). I confirmed with Security that we can accept the 90-day language for the pilot; they asked that we attach our SOC 2 summary and retention SOP as exhibit. I attached the proposed language and a SOC summary stub.

If Northbridge agrees, Legal will sign off the same day — no escalation needed.

Proposed next step for workflow:
- Jonas: send the SOW with the 90-day retention clause (we'll pre-fill our signature block).
- Elena/Tom: sign via DocuSign between 12/03–12/06.
- Marissa: e-sign SOW after DocuSign triggers and then Legal countersigns if doc is changed.

Dev
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: legal_redline_retention.txt, SOC2_summary.pdf
message_5_subject: Re: pilot timeline & MAP - need final signoff window
message_5_body:
Thanks — 12/03–12/06 works for procurement. Confirmed signers on our side: CFO (primary signature for SOW) and Head of Ops for the Order. We reviewed the 90-day retention language and that is acceptable for the pilot.

We expect procurement to finish redlines by EOD 11/24; can you confirm you'll share the DocuSign envelope once Legal adds the exhibit? If you can get the envelope out by 12/02 evening PST, we can route for signatures first thing 12/03.

—Elena
Attachment: NB_procurement_notes.pdf
message_6_subject: Re: pilot timeline & MAP - need final signoff window
message_6_body:
Perfect — thanks for the fast turnaround. I will: 
- Incorporate Dev's retention language and attach the SOC2 summary as Exhibit A.
- Finalize the SOW and queue a DocuSign envelope tonight (target 2026-12-02 19:00 PST).
- Set the MAP start date to 2026-12-07 in the agreement and in our internal kickoff calendar.

I'll share the DocuSign link and the signature schedule (.ics) as soon as the envelope is created. If anything changes at your end, ping me — otherwise we are GO for the 12/03–12/06 signature window with service start 12/07.

Thanks everyone — Jonas
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Signature_Schedule.ics
